name: Jordan M. Fox
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Denver, Colorado
about: Jordan M. Fox is an attorney providing legal services covering Family Law and General Litigation.

Jordan Fox, who practices law in Denver, Colorado, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2006 - 2027. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at University of Houston Law Center. He graduated in 1993. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 1994.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
